Name: Dewdrop
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
Dewdrop is a setup tool that creates a beautiful mod profile selector, letting you maintain multiple configurations and switch between them instantly, all by clicking Play in Steam! Perfect for players who want separate profiles for different playthroughs, testing new mods without breaking your main setup, or quickly launching pure vanilla when you want the original experience. Each profile uses its own mods folder so your configurations never interfere with each other. Just launch Stardew Valley through Steam, pick your profile from the pop-up menu, and play with exactly the mods you want for that session. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]1. Download and install the latest version of [/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][i][b]"Python" [/b][/i][b]& [/b][i][b]"SMAPI"[/b][/i][/size][/font]
2. Download this mod and unzip the contents
3. Run the script and follow the setup process
